name: Portal Branding
description: How the portal looks to the people who use it: its name, logo, colours, typeface and home page. Brand assets are uploaded here by the deploying organisation, so none of them live in the code.

fields.label: Portal Name
fields.description: Shown in the header, the browser tab, the sign-in page and the workspace.

fields.label: Organisation Name
fields.description: Used in the footer. Leave blank to show the portal name alone.

fields.label: Logo
fields.description: SVG or PNG, wide rather than square, readable on the header colour. Replaces the built-in mark.

fields.label: Primary Colour
fields.description: The main brand colour: buttons, links and the active tab. Lighter and darker shades are derived from it.

fields.label: Accent Colour
fields.description: A second colour for highlights such as the home page banner's call to action.

fields.label: Header Style
fields.description: A white header with a coloured logo suits a brand whose logo is designed for a light background.

fields.label: Font Family Name
fields.description: The name to give the uploaded font files, for example the brand typeface's name. Leave blank to use the operating system's interface font.

fields.label: Font File — Regular
fields.description: WOFF2 preferred. Only upload a font your organisation is licensed to serve.

fields.label: Font File — Bold
fields.description: Optional. Without it the browser emboldens the regular weight.

fields.label: Banner Heading
fields.default: Governance, risk and policy in one place
fields.description: The large heading at the top of the home page.

fields.label: Banner Text
fields.default: Find a forum, check where a policy stands, or raise a matter that needs attention — every record with its owner, its history and its next step.

fields.label: Banner Image
fields.description: A wide photograph or illustration, at least 1600 pixels across. The text sits on the left, so keep the subject to the right.

fields.label: Footer Text
fields.description: A line such as a classification notice or a support contact. Plain text.
